skill.summary: Generates GitHub README badges using shields.io. Triggers: add badge, shields io, readme badge, status badge.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of skylv-readme-badge.

- Generates customizable GitHub README badges using shields.io
- Supports triggers: add badge, shields io, readme badge, status badge
- Includes common badge examples and color conventions
- Offers multiple badge styles for flexibility
- MIT licensed and suitable for automation and tooling workflows
